name: github-account-switcher
description: Show active GitHub account in the status bar and quickly switch accounts using GitHub CLI (gh).

githubAccountSwitcher.refreshInterval.description: Interval in seconds to automatically refresh active GitHub account status (0 to disable automatic polling).

githubAccountSwitcher.statusBarAlignment.description: Alignment of the GitHub account item in the Status Bar.

githubAccountSwitcher.statusBarPriority.description: Priority order of the GitHub account item in the Status Bar (higher numbers appear further to the left in each section).

githubAccountSwitcher.showHost.description: Display host domain prefix in status bar when connected to non-github.com hosts (e.g. GitHub Enterprise).

githubAccountSwitcher.ghPath.description: Custom path to the GitHub CLI (gh) executable, if not found in system PATH.

githubAccountSwitcher.syncGitConfig.description: Automatically synchronize git config (user.name and user.email) when switching accounts ('local' updates current repo .git/config, 'global' updates global git config, 'off' disables sync).

githubAccountSwitcher.autoSwitchOnWorksp.description: Automatically detect local repository git identity (user.email, user.name, or remote origin URL) when opening a workspace and switch to the matching GitHub account.

githubAccountSwitcher.autoSwitchOnWindow.description: Automatically detect local repository git identity and switch to the matching GitHub account when returning/focusing this VS Code window.
